chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man about 25, short black hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.UNCLE_A: a stocky Moroccan man in his fifties, bald head, grey moustache, wearing a chocolate-brown djellaba
chars.UNCLE_B: a thin Moroccan man in his late forties, black curly hair, thick black moustache, wearing an olive-green tracksuit jacket
chars.FQIH: an elderly Moroccan man with a long white beard, white turban and a cream-white djellaba, holding prayer beads

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the earthen courtyard of an old rural house near Agadir, seen from the doorway where the nephew stands: the two uncles stand beside freshly dug holes half covered with cardboard, both raising open palms and shaking their heads in denial, nervous fake smiles, faces clearly visible, head-to-waist framing

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close-up in the same old earthen courtyard: the bald uncle puts his hand on his chest swearing an oath, eyes wide and pleading, sweat on his forehead, dug holes blurred behind him

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The young man stands with crossed arms facing his two uncles in the old earthen courtyard; the uncles talk at the same time, gesturing to explain themselves, the nephew frowning suspiciously

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The young man sits alone on an old wooden bench outside a rural earthen house at dusk, elbows on knees, looking down, torn between doubt and believing, argan trees and dry hills behind

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At night in a simple village room lit by one bulb, the young man suddenly sits up on a floor mattress with a sly determined look, eyes narrowed, as if he just got a clever plan

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Daytime in a dusty village lane: the young man knocks firmly on a blue wooden door of a small whitewashed house; the old fqih opens the door, surprised, prayer beads in hand

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest room with a straw mat and cushions: the young man leans forward pointing his finger at the old fqih, confident and accusing, as if he already knows everything; the fqih freezes, mouth open

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of the old fqih sitting on a cushion, frightened, sweating, gripping his prayer beads tightly, eyes darting to the side, a family photo frame on the wall behind him
